# ACIP - AI Content Intelligence Platform

> SEO-first content engine that plans topical authority and generates publish-ready articles at scale.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/bloggen-ai-content-platform
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
Building topical authority means producing large volumes of genuinely structured content. Done by hand it is slow and inconsistent; done naively with an LLM it produces undifferentiated text that does not rank.

A pipeline rather than a prompt. Topic planning establishes the cluster, distinct article templates enforce different structures - authority piece, deep dive, specialist, comparison, case study - and a generation stage fills them. Because each template has its own shape, the output does not collapse into one repeated format.

## Stack
Language: JavaScript, Node.js, Generation: LLM content pipeline, Templates: HTML and PHP article formats, Interface: Command-line pipeline runner

## Capabilities
- Topical authority planning
- Five distinct article templates
- Staged generation pipeline
- SEO-structured output
- CLI-driven batch production

## Outcomes
- Content volume achievable without one repeated article shape
- Structure decided by template rather than left to the model

## FAQ
Q: How is this different from prompting ChatGPT for blog posts?
A: The pipeline plans a topic cluster first and generates into five structurally different templates, so output varies in shape and serves a deliberate authority map.

Q: What does 'SEO-first' mean here?
A: Structure, internal linking and topical coverage are planned before generation, rather than edited in afterwards.

Q: Can it publish directly?
A: It emits publish-ready HTML and PHP for the target site.

Q: Is the source available?
A: Private; access on request.
